newsitem.title: USA: Senetek seeks approval for injection use.
newsitem.headline: Senetek seeks approval for injection use.

text.p: Senetek PLC said Tuesday it is seeking approval from the Food and Drug Administration to market its patented Auto Injector to deliver the drug epinephrine, which is used in the emergency treatment of severe allergic reactions (anaphylaxis) to insect stings, medicines, foods or other substances.
Senetek's Auto Injector is a compact, disposable, fully automatic, pre-filled autoinjector for self-injection by patients. It is designed to deliver a single dose of epinephrine.
Senetek PLC develops technologies for aging-related health problems.
